events.asset: atai Life Sciences psychedelic programs: partnership, collaboration or licensing agreement with a large pharmaceutical company
events.entity: atai Life Sciences (AtaiBeckley) and a large pharmaceutical company
events.title: A large pharmaceutical company partners with atai on a psychedelic program
events.proposition: atai Life Sciences announces a partnership, collaboration or licensing agreement with a large pharmaceutical company for one of its psychedelic programs.
events.criterion: TRUE on the date of the definitive public announcement (atai press release or SEC filing) of a partnership, collaboration, co-development or licensing agreement between atai Life Sciences, under any corporate name including AtaiBeckley or a successor, and a large pharmaceutical company, for one of atai's psychedelic programs. A large pharmaceutical company is one with annual revenue at or above US$10 billion in its last reported fiscal year. Rumours, letters of intent and non-binding term sheets do not count. An equity investment, a financing, a supply contract or a service contract without a program agreement does not count. FALSE at the deadline when no such announcement exists.

resolution_source.name: atai Life Sciences press releases; SEC EDGAR filings

readings: 'If they want exposure, they'll likely need to partner... with us' is read as an announced agreement between atai and a large pharmaceutical company; the counterparty decides, so the words are a prediction about an event, not an intention.
'Big Pharma' is read as a pharmaceutical company with annual revenue at or above US$10 billion.

related_timeline.event: Nature Medicine publishes MAPP1 phase 3: MDMA-assisted therapy beat placebo-with-therapy on CAPS-5 in 90 patients with severe chronic PTSD.
related_timeline.key_number: 67% vs 32% no longer met PTSD criteria; p<0.0001

related_timeline.event: Canada Gazette publishes SOR/2021-271, restoring Special Access Program requests for restricted drugs such as psilocybin and MDMA for patients with serious conditions.
DEA withdraws its proposed Schedule I placement of five tryptamines after hearing requests and says it will seek a new HHS scientific evaluation.
FDA approves Auvelity (dextromethorphan-bupropion), the first oral NMDA receptor antagonist for MDD, with labeled symptom improvement from week 1.
related_timeline.key_number: first new oral MDD mechanism in 60+ years

related_timeline.event: DEA withdraws its April 2022 proposal to place DOI and DOC in Schedule I, citing an amended procedure.
Colorado voters approve Proposition 122 (Natural Medicine Health Act), decriminalizing five plant psychedelics and authorizing regulated psilocybin healing centers.
Relmada's esmethadone fails a second large phase 3 depression trial two months after the October 2022 RELIANCE III miss; shares fall further.
atai lays off about 30% of staff and reviews its pipeline two months after the PCN-101 (R-ketamine) phase 2a miss.
Synthesis Institute, a psilocybin retreat operator and Oregon's largest facilitator-training program, confirms bankruptcy after running out of funding.
First temporary extension of COVID-19 telemedicine flexibilities for controlled medications through November 11, 2023, with a grace period to November 11, 2024 for existing relationships.
Governor signs SB23-290 (Natural Medicine Regulation and Legalization), creating the licensing framework for natural medicine facilitators and businesses.
FDA issues draft guidance 'Psychedelic Drugs: Considerations for Clinical Investigations' (docket FDA-2023-D-1987); comments due August 25, 2023.

events.asset: Psychedelic medicines (class) as a first-line treatment in a major clinical practice guideline for a psychiatric disorder
events.entity: American Psychiatric Association or another major clinical practice guideline body
events.title: A major practice guideline lists a psychedelic medicine as a first-line treatment
events.proposition: A major clinical practice guideline for a psychiatric disorder lists a psychedelic medicine as a first-line treatment option.
events.criterion: TRUE on the publication date, in the guideline body's own published guideline document, of a clinical practice guideline for a psychiatric disorder that lists a psychedelic medicine (for example psilocybin, MDMA, LSD or 5-MeO-DMT) as a first-line treatment option for that disorder. A major guideline body is the American Psychiatric Association, NICE, the VA/DoD, the WFSBP or CANMAT. A draft, a proposal or a public-comment version is not adoption. A guideline that names the medicine only for treatment-resistant, second-line, adjunctive or last-resort use does not count. FALSE at the deadline when no such guideline is published.

resolution_source.name: The published clinical practice guideline of the guideline body (American Psychiatric Association, NICE, VA/DoD, WFSBP or CANMAT)

readings: 'Psychedelics can become first-line' is read as the class, so any one psychedelic medicine listed as first-line resolves the event.
'Potentially even preventive treatments' is a second, weaker step in the same words and is not part of the condition; first-line listing alone resolves it.

events.asset: atai Life Sciences / AtaiBeckley common stock (Nasdaq: ATAI, or its successor listing): market capitalization at or above US$20 billion
events.title: atai Life Sciences market capitalization at or above US$20 billion
events.proposition: The market capitalization of atai Life Sciences (Nasdaq: ATAI, or its successor listing) is at or above US$20 billion at a market close, per Nasdaq closing price and shares outstanding in SEC filings.
events.criterion: Resolved on the named data series only: the market capitalization of atai Life Sciences (Nasdaq: ATAI, or its successor listing), computed as the Nasdaq closing share price multiplied by the shares outstanding stated on the cover page of atai's most recent periodic SEC filing on EDGAR. TRUE on the first trading day on which that closing market capitalization is at or above US$20 billion. The threshold is in the forecaster's words, so it resolves as binary at US$20 billion with no band. FALSE at the deadline when no market close has reached US$20 billion. If the shares stop trading with no successor listing and no price series has published 12 months after the deadline, the event is unresolvable. Realized values are stored, not scored.

events.asset: Midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD: health plan coverage of the drug and its therapy sessions
events.entity: Any US health insurer or health plan
events.title: A US health plan covers MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD
events.proposition: A US health insurer or health plan publishes a coverage policy or public bulletin that covers midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD, including the associated therapy sessions.
events.criterion: TRUE on the effective date of a published medical or coverage policy, fee schedule entry, NCD or LCD, or public policy bulletin from a US health insurer, health plan or government program (Medicare, Medicaid, VA or a commercial plan) that covers midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder and pays for both the drug and the therapy sessions delivered with it. A policy that covers the drug alone, a pilot announcement without a policy, or coverage of unapproved use does not count. FALSE at the deadline when no such policy has been published.

resolution_source.name: Payer policy bulletins; CMS Medicare Coverage Database

readings: 'Insurance will pay for it' names no payer; any US health insurer or program counts.
'It' is the drug plus therapy, so the policy must cover the therapy sessions as well as the drug.
FDA approval is a practical prerequisite but is not part of the criterion; the event cannot resolve TRUE without it.
